resources.string: Paste a public address, an extended public key (xpub, ypub, zpub) or an output descriptor. WatchWallet detects the chain automatically.
Could not check activity right now. You can still add it.
This looks like a valid address, but this network is not supported yet. Bitcoin and Ethereum-compatible networks work now; more chains are coming soon.
The letter case of this address does not match its checksum. It may contain a typo. Copy it again from the original source.
Several addresses were pasted. Use batch import to review and add them all at once.
This doesn’t look like a supported address
Check that you copied the whole address or key, without extra characters.
This looks like a seed phrase
This looks like a private key
WatchWallet never needs your seed phrase or private keys. The input was cleared and was not saved or sent anywhere. Use a public address or an extended public key (xpub) instead.
If someone asked you to enter it here or anywhere else, it is a scam.
Point the camera at an address or xpub QR code
Camera access is needed to scan QR codes. You can allow it in the app settings.

This looks like a Sui or Aptos address, but private keys of several chains look exactly the same. Nothing has been checked or sent yet. Pick the network of this address. If you copied a private key by mistake, clear it.
This address has never been used
If you copied a private key by mistake, clear it now and never share it. Add it only if you are sure this is a new, unused address.
This address is already part of %1$s
It will be added as its own wallet. If you subtract it from %1$s, its balance is not counted twice and you can follow both wallets separately.
